name: LiDAR4D
aliases: Dynamic Neural Fields for Novel Space-Time View LiDAR Synthesis
definition: A method combining U-Net-based global pattern preservation and data-driven detail prediction to achieve realistic ray-drop modeling for LiDAR synthesis.
summary: LiDAR4D is a differentiable volume rendering method for novel space-time view LiDAR synthesis that distinguishes itself by combining a U-Net-based global pattern preservation module with data-driven detail prediction to achieve realistic ray-drop modeling.
